title: Religión y conocimiento
goal: Read how religion and knowledge were closely tied across the Inca, Maya and Mexica worlds, and explain how a rediscovery sparked the study of indigenous medicine.
grammar: Conectores formales: a lo largo de, a raíz de

items: Explain what huacas and ceques were in the Inca empire.
Explain why losing a city's scribes was so damaging for the Maya.
Describe the role Mexica priests played in the emperor's decisions.
Explain how a rediscovery led historians to study pre-Hispanic indigenous medicine.
Use 'a lo largo de' and 'a raíz de' to describe historical spans and causes.
